result.brief: 提出免训练的生成精炼网络加速方法，通过自适应保留扩展与选择性token冻结减少精炼冗余，实现约2倍采样加速。
result.reason: Training-free acceleration of a binary-representation generative refinement network for image generation; no video, world-model, or representation-learning contribution, only indirect transfer to generation efficiency.
